preconditions: A prior customer-authored publication-state projection accepted a manuscript without changing its body.
The cited provider exchange contains both the exact manuscript shown to the editor and the exact acceptance report retained by that projection.
The current manuscript body is byte-identical to the manuscript body shown to the editor.
Only admitted deterministic front-matter fields differ between the reviewed manuscript and the current manuscript.
postconditions: An exact-digest controlled-migration projection is appended to Koios's editorial-judgments ledger.
The projection cites the prior acceptance, provider exchange, reviewed manuscript, and current manuscript by digest.
No model is invoked and no prose, source claim, or editorial report is regenerated.
refusals: The editor prompt or completion cannot be tied exactly to the prior acceptance.
A front-matter difference is outside the admitted deterministic fields.
The prior projection is not an accepted body-preserving customer projection.
